newsitem.title: USA: Missouri Gov signs $332 mln tax cut package.
newsitem.headline: Missouri Gov signs $332 mln tax cut package.

text.p: Missouri Gov. Mel Carnahan signed a $332 million tax cut package Thursday which eliminates the state portion of the sales tax on food.

Elimination of the three percent general state sales tax on food accounted for $230 million of the cuts, with additional relief coming in the form of added tax deductions for private pensioners and certain charitable contributions.

Local sales taxes on food, which vary throughout Missouri, will not be affected when the law takes effect on Oct. 1. The Missouri General Assembly passed the legislation in mid-May at the end of their regular session.
